outputs.explanation: Panel A includes bar graphs (quantification of HMGB1 band intensity in nuclear, cytosolic, and mitochondrial fractions) presented as mean ± SD with error bars, but no individual data points (e.g., dots for each of the N=4 replicates) are overlaid on the bars.
Panel B is an immunoelectron micrograph showing gold-silver particle staining; it is not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel C is a western blot showing HMGB1 detection across differently purified mitochondrial/cytosolic/nuclear fractions with no accompanying quantification plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel D is a western blot (proteinase K protection assay) with no accompanying quantification plot, so the check does not apply.
